humanReview.verdict: rejected — agent self-scores were inflated; every category re-scored from the board against the turnaround

measuredFidelity.note: Ankle daylight was the last one outside it -- 30.2% against the turnaround's 46.9% -- and it was a RIG fact, not a sculpt one: the leg width at that height already matched (0.245ft vs 0.241ft), the leg CENTRELINE did not. The canonical rig now carries the concept's 6.75 degree leg splay; see render.legStance in scripts/measures.json. Delivered 48.5%. The six 1-5 scores below are the round-4 critic's and are untouched by this pass -- the sculptor does not score its own work.

frontProfileSilhouette.label: front/profile silhouette
frontProfileSilhouette.note: Critic (round 4 final): Front large-read is right: head silhouette width at the brow row / head height = 0.777 in junebug-front-review.png (150px over 193px) against the turnaround's 0.774 (229/296) — within 0.4%. The ear silhouette step is correctly PLACED but shallow: it starts at y=188 = 63.2% of head height (concept y=263 = 64.5%), takes 36 rows = 18.7% of head height (concept 57 rows = 19.3%), and gains only 7px per side = 4.7% of head width against the concept's 13px = 5.8%. Profile departs: in junebug-profile-review.png the headband ends in a flat-cut stub on the crown (x=309, y=143), above and behind the ear, where the turnaround's band sweeps down behind the ear to the jaw; the nape hair ends in a hard triangular spike; the ponytail ends in a blunt club instead of the concept's tapered flick; the shoe is a cream toe blob butt-joined to a spherical cream heel bulb over a floating slab midsole. The profile nose is no longer a blocker: 12px protrusion (silhouette min x=209 at y=225 against x=221 at y=205), where the concept's 14px scales to 9px at this head size.

headBodyProportions.label: head/body proportions
headBodyProportions.note: Critic (round 4 final): Measurably the strongest category. Head height / figure height = 193/578 = 33.4% in junebug-front-review.png against the turnaround's 296/879 = 33.7%; brow-to-chin / head height = 0.591 in both, to three decimals. What blocks 5 is joint form, not proportion: junebug-runtime-run.png shows a visible ring seam at the shoulder where the sleeve meets the deltoid, an elbow that reads as two stacked tapered cylinders, and hands whose fingers are splayed separated spikes with outline gaps between them — rakes, not child hands. The jersey sleeve is also a cap that ends at the shoulder in junebug-front-review.png where the turnaround's sleeve reaches mid-upper-arm, which shortens the arm's read.

hairMass.label: hair mass
hairMass.note: Critic (round 4 final): Capped by the rubric's own words before any measurement: the mass is smooth and featureless with zero strand grouping anywhere in junebug-runtime-hero.png or junebug-profile-review.png, and 3.3 says a smooth blob caps at 4. It scores below that because the named round-4 blocker is not fixed — at the brow row (y=145) of junebug-front-review.png the right temple carries 11px of hair = 7.2% of the 152px head width and the left 6px = 3.9%, against the ~2.8% target and the turnaround's 2px = 0.87% (measured identically at its brow row y=193 across a 230px head). The two sides differ by 5px, so the head reads lopsided. In junebug-profile-review.png the mass covers the whole back skull and terminates at the nape in a hard triangular point where the turnaround's nape hairline is a rounded arc.

clothingConstruction.label: clothing construction
clothingConstruction.note: Critic (round 4 final): Real construction exists — V-neck trim, two shoulder stripes per side, a sleeve cuff ring, belt loops with a buckle and a button placket all read in junebug-front-review.png — but three things fail. Laces: one flat white rectangle bar in junebug-front-review.png and two grey pin nubs in junebug-profile-review.png, against the turnaround's three rounded lace straps plus tongue and collar. Shoe colour is inverted: over the lower third of the shoe body junebug-front-review.png measures 3.1% red / 60.4% cream against the turnaround's 55.2% red / 29.2% cream. Belt: the delivered belt sits 20.1 luminance counts from the pants it crosses, where the turnaround's dark-red belt sits 56.7 counts from its salmon pants — the belt has lost its identity as a separate garment. Kit separation is generally flat too: jersey-vs-pants luminance gap 36.3 against the concept's 59.2.

faceExpressionRead.label: face/expression read
faceExpressionRead.note: Critic (round 4 final): The profile-nose blocker is genuinely fixed (12px break, above the 9px scale-equivalent of the concept's 14px). Everything else short of 4. The front nose still misses its number: at the scale-matched sampling band (junebug-front-review.png rows 218-228, nose half-width 9px, cheeks at ±45px) the nose reads 131.8 against a lit-side cheek of 126.5 = +5.3, short of the +8 target and of the turnaround's +11.3/+13.2 at the equivalent band; over the tip rows 222-232 it inverts to -3.1. The image-left cheek carries an unexplained dark patch — a 44.5-count left-right cheek delta against a global render asymmetry of only 15.8 at the forehead and 15.8 at the jaw, where the turnaround's cheeks differ by 2.0. In junebug-profile-review.png the eye is a white decal wedge sitting on the face's silhouette edge under a floating black brow slab, and there is no mouth and no chin break at all, where the turnaround's profile carries a lip line, a chin and a mentolabial crease. The mouth itself is fine in front (dark run 26px = 21.3% of face width, min L 46, against the concept's 31px = 14.0%, min L 51).

heroAndFieldScale.label: hero + 40px read
heroAndFieldScale.note: Critic (round 4 final): At a true 40px downscale (front review and turnaround front figure both extracted to their alpha bbox and lanczos-resized to 40px tall) the identity survives: white band stripe, dark red jersey, salmon pants, dark socks, pale shoes. It survives less well than the concept given the same treatment — the temple wedge darkens the face so it reads as a dark-framed mask rather than the concept's open oval, the two feet fuse into one pale blob (ankle daylight 3% of leg-pair width against the turnaround's 40-48%), and the legs read as one column. At hero scale junebug-runtime-hero.png shows hard posterized shading facets across the cheek and jaw, the far eye collapsing to a smudge behind the nose mass, an ear that is a plain oval pad, and a hair mass with no internal detail.
